title: H478: OB filter on H411 Var B — OB pattern applied to actual H-series champion (OOS 4.825)
rationale: H476 tested OB filter on H417 60-stock universe, but discovered H417's baseline was weak (OOS 0.383, not 5.855 as inflated CLAUDE.local.md claimed). The OB filter still lifted baseline by 5× (0.383→1.929). The appropriate test is to apply OB filter to the ACTUAL H-series champion: H411 Var B (30-stock NASDAQ universe, 1/price rank × 20d drift gate, top-2, IS=3.940, OOS=4.825, MaxDD=-1.2%). This is directly analogous to H344 (OB filter on H198, lifted 1.174→3.396, +189%). If the same ~2× improvement applies, H478 could reach OOS Sharpe ~9-10 — which would be an extraordinary result if real. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 4.825 (H411 Var B) AND MaxDD improvement >= 0.5pp (H411 MaxDD already very low at -1.2%). H478 is the single highest-priority backtest given the established track record of OB filter on related strategies.

H411 Var B is the strongest baseline in the family, so improvement should be at least proportional.
